title: Morning Run - Real Momentum

beats.shot_text: Lace-Up Ritual — Early morning light hits a quiet outdoor track; a young runner kneels down to tie their shoes. Action: They pull the laces tight with a confident tug, tapping the heel to secure the fit

First Burst of Motion — Close-up of the shoes hitting the ground, dust lifting slightly as they accelerate. Action: They push off into a steady run, stride smooth and powerful, energy building with each step
